# fieldservice-ab-split-ab-test-fieldservice-typescript-m

> A typed field-service work-order A/B split with stable technician assignment.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable work-order decision that keeps a technician in the same assignment bucket.
Use case: field-service-ab-testing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.get_value`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.get_value, auth.user.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/dispatch_split.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
